project_name: Cloud Loop — AI-Powered Opportunity Discovery Engine
tagline: Unifying student programs, hackathons, and fresher jobs with IBM Db2, Supabase, and RAG AI.
hackathon: IBM Db2 TechX Summit @ GL Bajaj, Mathura

ibm_db2_integration.usage_summary: Enterprise data tier with schema definitions for OPPORTUNITIES, USER_SEARCHES, AI_RECOMMENDATIONS, and ANALYTICS_EVENTS. Implements parameterized CRUD queries, search logging telemetry, and automatic data synchronization.
ibm_db2_integration.fallback_mechanism: Graceful degradation to Supabase and in-memory cache when credentials are not present or network is sandboxed.
